findings.claim: Non-complete PR/audit resume overwrites saved reviewed inputs before comparing them.
findings.reproduction: Saved stage=pr/snapshot OLD + source NEW returns pr-open after zero reviews.
findings.recommendation: Compare every saved stage before updating inputs. Source changes or audit repairs must invalidate earlier whole-plan reviews while preserving cap and durable resume semantics.

findings.claim: Default repair receives the original review brief and drops the actual current findings.
findings.reproduction: Major UNIQUE_CURRENT_FAILURE_TO_REPAIR is absent from captured writer prompt; operation remains review-whole-plan.
findings.recommendation: Deliver an explicit bounded repair prompt, current findings/evidence and required verification through supported noninteractive writer invocation, including proper stdin.

findings.claim: A fresh page validates changed source using stale completed reviews.
findings.reproduction: Complete review for v1, change source to v2, GET a fresh final page and POST its authentic form: HTTP200 and final gate true with old review snapshot.
findings.recommendation: Bind successful plan-end reviews to source/input identity and enforce it in the button plus proof reader/final gate. Missing/stale review identity must fail closed; positive fixtures must have authentic current reviewed evidence.

findings.claim: OPEN verdict can advance if findings are medium or lower; combined review discards local verdict.
findings.reproduction: Plan PASSED; audit OPEN + medium finding + intent missing + coverage nao faz produces succeeded receipt and opens PR.
findings.recommendation: Require accepted stage-specific verdicts from both legs in addition to severity. An OPEN leg must not be turned into successful receipt. Keep the three-round repair/stop semantics.

findings.claim: Shared test still expects an ISO timestamp alone to validate.
findings.reproduction: Full suite adds one failure beyond the 28 baseline failures; old expectation true vs actual false.
findings.recommendation: Migrate obsolete expectation to the new authenticated contract without weakening gate; retain positive HTTP evidence checks.
